title: The Lost Runner
description: Dex Rinn, a smuggler, is worried about his friend Jax, a spice runner who was supposed to make a delivery two days ago but never came back. The route goes through the desert between Sythmar and Tann Province. It's dangerous out there—Dune Nomads, syndicate patrols, sandstorms. Can you help find him?
shortDescription: Find a missing spice runner in the Sytha desert

objectives.description: Speak with Dex Rinn about his missing friend
Search the spice runner's route through the desert
Find the missing runner (alive or dead)
Return to Dex with news (and cargo if found)
